decisions.reason: The source changes the displayed badge catalog and row arrangement, not the referral milestones, award conditions, or on-chain award recording.
The FAQ describes badges generically without listing the Legend badge, total badge count, or dashboard row arrangement, so its current copy remains valid.
The landing-page mechanics copy concerns commissions and prize mechanics and contains no badge-catalog or badge-layout state affected by this decision.
The About page only mentions badges generically as gamification and does not identify the Legend badge, badge count, or dashboard arrangement.
Badge catalog and row-layout changes do not alter the landing-page book-cover placement, size, or visibility requirements.
The Mission page mentions badges and leaderboards only at a general level, with no catalog membership, count, or row-layout detail to revise.
The badge display decision does not change the hero headline, CTA, layout, subtitles, or selling-point emphasis.
Changing the badge catalog and dashboard arrangement does not affect the mint-number referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing methods, or display surfaces.
The badge count and arrangement do not change the current or planned product names.
The badge presentation change does not alter the Small Block prize amount, winner count, ticket window, draw trigger, or revenue allocation.
Removing the Legend badge from the displayed catalog does not negate the existing requirement that permanent badges remain visible in metadata, and no Legend-specific metadata key exists to remove.
The audited source Event concerns badge catalog and layout only; the separate first-mint discussion in the same message does not change the USDC wallet-mint requirement.
